title: K-th Digit in Infinite String
statement: An infinite string is built by concatenating the decimal representations of the positive integers in blocks, where block b holds the positive integers from 10*b through 10*b + 9. Even-numbered blocks are appended in increasing order and odd-numbered blocks in decreasing order, so the string runs 1 through 9, then 19 down to 10, then 20 up to 29, then 39 down to 30, and so on. Given k as large as 10^15, return the k-th digit of this string, counting from 1.
